verdicts.proof: Old: login_screen.dart:123-133 refuses an empty e-mail or password with a toast. v2 has two ways in, the CTA (login_view_v2.dart:120-122, MgCta onTap: onLogin) and keyboard Done on the password field (login_view_v2.dart:108-109). Both call _doLogin (login_screen.dart:282), and the same empty check runs at :123. On v2 (MgV2.peek, :124) it sets _v2EmailErr/_v2PassErr (:125-128), which go to AsmField error (login_view_v2.dart:95,105) and then to InputDecoration.errorText (core/v2/widgets/mg_inputs.dart:38). The errors stay under the fields until the customer edits a field (_clearV2Errors :266-269).

Old: login_buttons.dart:23-25 disables the button and shows a spinner while _loading. v2: MgCta busy: loading (login_view_v2.dart:123), and mg_cta.dart:137 draws the spinner and :212-217 drops the tap. The keyboard Done key still calls _doLogin while a login is running, in both looks: old login_form_fields.dart:122, v2 login_view_v2.dart:109. _doLogin itself has no loading check, so this gap is the same in both looks and is not new.

The same AuthService.signIn call is used (login_screen.dart:136; auth_provider.dart:116-163, AuthErrorMapper.signIn). For a known e-mail, v2 calls showLoginFailedV2 (login_screen.dart:148-149). That is a red state sheet using the same error.title and error.message (login_states_v2.dart:17-31; the chunk's line refs 297-311 are wrong, the file has 109 lines). It has 'Zkusit znovu', which closes the sheet with the form still filled (mg_state_sheet.dart:118), and 'Poslat nové heslo', which runs the same _forgotPassword. The sheet stays until closed, so it is clearer than the 7-second toast.

The check is inside AuthService.signIn (auth_provider.dart:127-136, _profileExists false: signOut and code profile_missing), which v2 reaches through the same _doLogin. The orphaned auth.users row still exists, so check_web_booking_email (which reads auth.users, STATE_3:344) returns true. The flow then reaches showLoginFailedV2 (login_screen.dart:148-149) with the same title 'loginError' and text 'accountNoLongerExists'. Small v2 oddity: the sheet's secondary action is 'Poslat nové heslo', but a password reset cannot help here, because login would still end in profile_missing. The body text still says to register again, and the block itself is not weakened.
verdicts.fix_idea: Optional: in showLoginFailedV2, when error.code == 'profile_missing', change the tertiary action to 'Zaregistrovat se' (_openRegister(unknown: true)) instead of 'Poslat nové heslo'.

verdicts.proof: The same AuthService.emailExists RPC (auth_provider.dart:168-177, check_web_booking_email) runs in the same branch (login_screen.dart:143-147). In v2, _showUnknownEmailDialog goes to showUnknownEmailV2 (login_screen.dart:166-168; login_states_v2.dart:35-45). It is a modal confirm with Cancel / Register, and Register runs the same _openRegister(unknown: true). If the answer is null (offline), both looks fall back to the normal error (:146-156).

The redirect sits in the single GoRouter config (router.dart:228-259) and does not depend on the look. _authRequired (router.dart:184-203) is identical to 4.1.3 except that Routes.protocol was removed together with its route, in an earlier merged PR (3e872afe), not by v2. Every GoRoute path matches 4.1.3 minus /protocol. v2 adds no new routes: it swaps views only below the redirect (V2Switch / MgV2.on inside the screens). The v2 shell tabs, cart CTA, booking_entry, message rows and SOS entries all use context.go/push, so the redirect runs. A grep of every v2 file for imperative Navigator.push/MaterialPageRoute finds only route viewers: rt_photo_viewer_v2.dart:24, recorder_screen_v2.dart:29, trip_detail_screen_v2.dart:33, ride_merge_v2.dart:32. None of them reaches booking, payment, profile, messages, SOS or checkout. The /app/ App-Link rewrite (router.dart:229-235) returns a new location, and go_router runs the redirect again on it.

Shared redirect, router.dart:242-250, with the recovery exception that uses AuthService.recoveryInProgress. That flag is set in verifyOtp (auth_provider.dart:460-474) and cleared in ResetPasswordScreen at reset_password_screen.dart:73 (dispose) and :208. The v2 reset view is drawn inside the same ResetPasswordScreen widget (MgV2.peek branches at :54,106,119,147), so the same dispose runs. The rule is silent in both looks (Home is shown instead), which is the same as before.

ForcedSignOut.pending is set in shared code (main.dart:372,389; auth_guard.dart:55). login_screen.dart:59-66 checks MgV2.peek and sets _v2SignedOut. LoginViewV2 then shows a persistent MgStateBanner with a lock icon, the heading v2UxAsmSignedOutTitle and the same text eoForcedSignOut (login_view_v2.dart:76-84). This is clearer than the 8-second toast.

profileProvider (auth_provider.dart:55-75) is a shared data provider: when no profile row exists and the account is not freshly registered, it signs the customer out. The sign-out triggers _AuthNotifier (router.dart:208-212), and the redirect sends the customer to login. Nothing in v2 changes or skips it. It is silent in both looks.

The v2 entry points are the 'forgotPassword' text button (login_view_v2.dart:113-116, onTap: onForgot) and 'Poslat nové heslo' in the failed-login sheet (login_states_v2.dart:26-29). Both call the same _forgotPassword (login_screen.dart:246-253, pushes /reset-password?email=).

The v2 Register ghost button (login_view_v2.dart:136) runs onRegister, which is _openRegister() (login_screen.dart:285). The unknown-email confirm runs _openRegister(unknown: true) (:167). The carry rule is at :99-105, and the rule is new on this branch for both looks (4.1.3 just pushed Routes.register).

v2 bioVisible is _bioAvailable && _bioEnabled (login_screen.dart:278), the same flags as the old check at :385 (set in _checkBiometric :107-117). login_view_v2.dart:127-130 renders the button only if bioVisible. v2 also disables it during a password login (:129), which is stricter than the old look.

The v2 bio button calls onBio, which is _doBioLogin (login_screen.dart:283). The same BiometricService.authenticateResult check runs at :195-211. The same showMotoGoToast is used, and in v2 it renders as showMgToastRich with the same title, message and duration (widgets/toast_helper.dart:20-31). The clarity is the same as in the old look (both are short toasts).

bioRestoreSession returns offline at login_screen.dart:220. On v2 (:222-224), showBioOfflineV2 shows a warn sheet with a wifi-off icon, the heading v2UxAsmOfflineTitle, the text eoBioOffline and 'Zkusit znovu', which closes the sheet and reruns _doBioLogin (login_states_v2.dart:49-63). Biometric data is not cleared, as in the old look. The chunk's line refs 329-343 are wrong; the actual lines are 49-63.
